# Eclipse Timekeeping by Eclipse Systems

Eclipse Systems sells Eclipse Timekeeping, Mission Command by Eclipse, Eclipse project billing, and Eclipse Suite for U.S. small businesses, law firms, and shift-based teams, with a beachhead focus on Birmingham, Alabama. Eclipse Suite includes the three non-legal products. Eclipse Legal is a specialized add-on for firms that need matter-aware billing.

Products are priced per seat per month: Eclipse Timekeeping is $10, Mission Command by Eclipse is $18, Eclipse is $22, Eclipse Suite is $38, and Eclipse Legal Add-on is $20. Annual billing gives a 20% discount. All paid products include a 14-day card-required trial.

Eclipse Timekeeping is not the Eclipse IDE Timekeeper plugin, Total Eclipse court reporting software, or TimeCamp's Eclipse integration. The canonical product name is Eclipse Timekeeping by Eclipse Systems.
